gk.description: Core Studio Base Plugin: guided /quickstart setup, brand folder organizer, website color and font extractor, Brand Voice Guide builder, visual Approval Board, and automatic backup restore.

gk-social.description: Social Content & Brand Voice Engine: industry topic radar, plain-English drafting for LinkedIn, Instagram, X, and Telegram, visual Approval Board review, and voice learning from approved edits.

gk-design.description: Brand Design, Slide Decks & Campaign Pages: multi-size PNG social banners, 16:9 and 4:5 HTML, PDF, and editable PowerPoint slide decks, and standalone conversion landing pages.

gk-motion.description: Animated Infographics & Carousels: rebuild reference infographic layouts in your brand palette and export 1080x1350 PNG and PDF carousel cards plus animated MP4 visuals.

gk-video.description: Short-Form Video & Talking-Head PiP Reel Engine (9:16): write 60-second website teardown scripts, capture live proof screenshots, trim silences and retakes locally on your Mac, render 1080x1920 Picture-in-Picture reels, and package platform captions.

gk-agency.description: Agency Prospect Audit & Content Repurposing: turn any public website URL into a 5-slide branded audit deck, 2 sample social posts, and 1 benchmark graphic before sales calls, or repurpose one webinar into a full campaign sprint.

gk-director.description: Creative Director, Motion Styles & Direct-Response Copy: focused campaign positioning questions (/brainstorm-angle), precision UI and motion polish (/emil-design-polish), 59 commercial motion styles + 98 film anthology specs (/opuscar-director), classic direct-response copywriting structures (/copy-legend), and parallel multi-brand sprints (/parallel-sprint).

05-agency-growth.description: Agency Prospect Audit & Content Repurposing: turn any public website URL into a 5-slide branded audit deck, 2 sample social posts, and 1 benchmark graphic before sales calls, or repurpose one webinar into a full campaign sprint.

06-brainstorm-and-director.description: Creative Director, Motion Styles & Direct-Response Copy: focused campaign positioning questions (/brainstorm-angle), precision UI and motion polish (/emil-design-polish), 59 commercial motion styles + 98 film anthology specs (/opuscar-director), classic direct-response copywriting structures (/copy-legend), and parallel multi-brand sprints (/parallel-sprint).

brainstorm-angle.description: Use before drafting any campaign, landing page, deck, or video to run a 1-question-at-a-time interview that locks topic, channels, goal, and sources into a campaign brief.

brand-banners.description: Use when generating branded social media banners (#06 social-banner-sheet: 1200x628, 1080x1350, 1080x1080, 1080x1920) in HTML/SVG and exporting high-DPI PNGs.

brand-extract.description: Use when given a website URL or local HTML file to extract brand colors, fonts, and WCAG 2.2 AA contrast pairs into your brand folder.

brand-teardown-script.description: Use when scripting a 60-second 9:16 brand teardown video scored by the 4-factor hook retention model and 3.2 words/sec beat budget.

build-infographic.description: Use when rendering a 1080x1350 LinkedIn infographic (#01 comparison-grid, #02 step-by-step-flow, #03 iceberg-breakdown) as crisp PNG/PDF and 30fps animated MP4 in brand tokens.

claude-md.description: Use when creating, updating, or compacting global (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, <=60 lines) or project-bound (./CLAUDE.md, <=120 lines) instruction files, brand summaries, ToV pointers, and active vs on-demand skill profiles.

claude-md-builder.description: Backwards-compatible alias for /claude-md: create, update, or compact global (<=60 lines), project (<=120 lines), and per-client (<=150 lines) CLAUDE.md instruction files.

client-audit-pack.description: Use when generating a 5-minute prospect pitch pack: 7-channel website teardown, prospect-branded HTML/PDF/PPTX audit deck (#10 standalone-audit-deck), 2 sample posts, and 1 static benchmark infographic (#11 standalone-infographic).

clone-layout-style.description: Use when reverse-engineering a reference infographic grid, spacing rhythm, and motion curve without copying creator IP.

copy-legend.description: Use when drafting or rewriting headlines, landing pages, emails, or social posts through proven direct-response and editorial copywriting lenses.

cost-check.description: Use before running optional external paid APIs to check or reserve estimated USD spend against per-run and daily safety limits.

discover-claude-code.description: Use when onboarding a marketer to Claude Desktop, explaining brand folders, slash commands, and visual browser pages.

draft-post.description: Use when drafting LinkedIn, Instagram, X, or Telegram posts in the client Tone of Voice verified by readability checks.

emil-design-polish.description: Use when building or reviewing landing pages, slide decks, interactive HTML boards, or UI animations with precision spring-physics UI and motion polish.

harvest-visual-proof.description: Use when capturing high-DPI website, headline, and pricing proof screenshots for a short-form teardown video or audit deck.

launch-page.description: Use when building a conversion-focused lead-magnet, webinar, or course landing page (#07 conversion-launch-page) exported as a self-contained HTML bundle.

opuscar-director.description: Use when directing code-generated films, animated explainers, or parameterized ad batches using Lemo-Opuscar (59 modular library styles #12..#70 + 98 film anthology showcase specs), Remotion, or the HTML stage compositor.

panic-undo.description: Use when the user wants to preview or roll back the last change to their voice file, brand design guide, instruction sheet, or campaign drafts.

parallel-sprint.description: Use when running multi-channel campaign launches, multi-prospect agency teardowns, or batch asset production across isolated parallel subagents.

provider-connector.description: Use when checking local tool readiness or connecting optional external API keys safely without pasting secrets into chat.

publish-shortform.description: Use when packaging approved 9:16 reels with platform-native captions into a local review-pack.zip or publishing via configured social APIs.

quickstart.description: Use when setting up any new or existing project folder: asks brand URL/materials and frequent job types, configures Always-Active vs 0-token on-demand skills, extracts Brand and Tone-of-Voice .md files, writes ./CLAUDE.md, and stops cleanly.

render-avatar-reel.description: Use when compositing a 60-second 9:16 short-form video (#08 reel-9x16-pip, #09 capture-avatar-stage) with circular PiP avatar video or portrait, cleaned spoken audio, and synced captions.

repurpose-pack.description: Use when turning a webinar transcript, course lesson, or long-form video into a multi-format social and content campaign matched to your installed pack.

review-board.description: Use when opening the browser Approval Board, exporting local or encrypted client review packs, and applying saved human approval decisions.

setup-marketer.description: Use when setting up a marketing studio folder, creating brand workspaces, checking local Mac or Windows tools, or configuring Claude Desktop.

slide-deck.description: Use when building viewport-locked 16:9 HTML/PDF/PPTX presentation decks (#04 exec-deck-16x9) or 4:5 carousels (#05 social-carousel-4x5) styled in extracted brand tokens.

splicebay-studio.description: Use when cutting spoken retakes, trimming dead air, and balancing spoken audio locally or via an optional Splicebay Video Editor server.

topic-radar.description: Use when scanning industry news, RSS, Hacker News, Reddit, or optional connected research sources for high-signal content angles.

tov-extract.description: Use when analyzing 3 to 20 sample posts or transcripts to build a structured Tone-of-Voice profile in your brand folder.

what-worked.description: Use after Approval Board sign-off to diff human edits against drafts, log campaign learnings, and apply confirmed voice rules.

run-brand-setup.description: Use when setting up a new client workspace, extracting brand tokens from a website, seeding Tone of Voice, and checking providers.

run-competitor-audit.description: Use when running a 5-minute 7-channel competitor or prospect teardown and generating a prospect-branded audit deck, 2 sample posts, and 1 benchmark infographic.

run-creative-director.description: Use when brainstorming a campaign angle, directing a code-built Lemo-Opuscar or Remotion film, applying precision spring-physics UI and motion polish, or running a classic direct-response copywriting pass.

run-daily-social.description: Use when running the daily social and channel copy workflow: topic radar scan, human-voice post drafting for LinkedIn, Instagram, X, or Telegram, Approval Board sign-off, and voice learning.

run-data-motion.description: Use when creating LinkedIn creator infographics or 30fps animated data visuals in 1080x1350 4:5 format.

run-deck-or-page.description: Use when building branded social banner packs, 16:9 HTML/PDF/PPTX slide decks, or lead-magnet and webinar landing pages.

run-short-video.description: Use when turning a brand teardown or raw talking-head take into a ready-to-publish 9:16 short-form video reel with PiP avatar and captions.

gk-renderer.description: Use for forked HTML/SVG banner generation, 16:9 slide decks, CRO launch pages, 1080x1350 animated infographics, and 9:16 PiP video rendering.

gk-researcher.description: Use for forked brand CSS/HTML extraction, 7-channel web/social teardowns, topic radar scans, visual proof harvesting, and layout vision deconstruction.
